payload.purpose_context: The release workflow only publishes on a green nightly for the tagged commit. Three nightly reds remain: a bare-slug coordination Mission cannot consolidate onto a protected target, three performance budget tests fail on slow shared runners, and a commit-recipe gate flags help text and is not run per pull request. This mission fixes each at its structural cause and delivers them as one pull request.
payload.purpose_tldr: Make the nightly integration, performance and interpreter suites green on main so the 4.0.0rc6 release gate can pass.

payload.question: Bare-slug coordination Mission has two directory names and three classifiers keyed on one (#5651). Which fix?

payload.final_answer: Alias authority: keep the composed coordination directory; one exact alias set {primary dir name, composed <slug>-<mid8>} consumed by the partition classifier, the bookkeeping exemption and the teardown metadata read. Edits _is_bookkeeping in consolidation/reconciliation.py (adjacent to #5668).

payload.question: Claiming tests/specify_cli/cli/commands as a per-PR shard is blocked by the nested-claim rule. How does the recipe gate get a per-PR home?

payload.final_answer: Move the gate: the recipe scanner test moves to tests/architectural (precedent #4479); the directory stays nightly-only and is cross-referenced on #4708/#4732/#5652.

payload.question: Alias authority lands two directories on the target for a bare-slug coordination Mission (measured). What end state?

payload.final_answer: Alias + fold to one dir: keep the alias authority; the target ends with one directory (the primary bare one) holding the full event log; seeded composed-directory records are projected back onto the primary directory on landing.

payload.wp_title: Track B: git-subprocess count pin for owned-checkout commands
Track C: recipe-shape classifier and per-pull-request home for the gate
Track A: consolidation consumers and one directory on the target
Track A enablers: teardown identity read and structured seed refusal
Track A: refused seed commit stops consolidate with its real cause
Closing records: alias decision record, ADR index, changelog, docs index
Track A: directory alias authority and partition classification
